claimMatrix.plainLanguageFinding: Within-context directions are heterogeneous; contexts failing the declared coverage gate remain descriptive only.
claimMatrix.caution: Exact two-sided p-values have a minimum of 1/3 with two mice per arm.

claimMatrix.plainLanguageFinding: Shared-context C0/C1 observed-mixture elongation delta was -0.0125.
claimMatrix.caution: This combines context mixture and within-context morphology and weights only morphology-evaluable tiles; the all-frozen-tile-share sensitivity is separate.

claimMatrix.plainLanguageFinding: Equal C0/C1 descriptive delta was -0.0191; all included contexts passed the support gate, so no separate sensitivity was needed.
claimMatrix.caution: Decomposition composition term +0.0015 is descriptive, not causal.

claimMatrix.plainLanguageFinding: Composition-sensitive C0/C1/C2 whole-tumour response elongation delta was -0.0144.
claimMatrix.caution: This mixes context emergence/proportions with residual-nucleus morphology. Equal weighting across all response contexts is not estimable when the emergent context is absent from Vehicle.

limitations: Only 4 mice are available, with two mice and one WSI per treatment arm.
The C0–C1 treatment restriction is post-hoc and exploratory; it must be confirmed in an independently specified and replicated analysis.
Mouse is the experimental unit; nuclei and tiles are never treatment replicates.
Exact two-sided randomization p-values have a minimum attainable value of 2/6=1/3.
Restricted cluster fractions are compositional and cannot be interpreted independently.
Observed-mixture effects combine context proportions and within-context morphology.
The Kitagawa/Oaxaca decomposition and observed-minus-standardized contrast are descriptive, non-causal algebra.
Classifiers use tiles from the same H&E sections used to define clusters and are not independent pathology validation.
All cluster identities remain provisional pending pathologist review.
